# RoboticNetworking.com

Independent reference project on robotic networking, interoperability, and communication infrastructures for autonomous systems.

## Canonical Resource

- [Home](https://roboticnetworking.com/)


## Purpose

RoboticNetworking.com provides an independent reference on robotic networking, communication architectures, interoperability, and networking infrastructures for autonomous and connected robotic systems.

## Repository

- [Robotic Networking Evidence Repository](https://github.com/robotic-infrastructure/roboticnetworking-evidence)
